contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ HADRIANVS AVGVSTVS ; R/ COS III

A complete Roman silver coin: denarius of Hadrian, part of a hoard dating AD176. Reverse: COS III, Spes advancing left. RIC 181 BMC 417. Reece period 6. Obverse: Laureate bust right Obverse inscription: HADRIANVS AVGVSTVS Reverse: Spes advancing left Reverse inscription: COS III. The three coins were within a circle of 10m and at a depth of around 15 cm
